thread:
Ryan (Sales): Hey team — Helios Health wants a hosted POC tomorrow 9–11am PST. They expect ~25 RPS sustained, bursts to 50 RPS for ~2 hours. Can we get a temporary rate exception and an ephemeral scoped key? Need IP allowlist too.
Emma (SE): @Ryan can you share the org_id + project_id and the specific endpoints they'll hit? Also do they need streaming or just standard generate/embeddings?
Ryan (Sales): Org: helios-prod, Project: hh-poc. They'll hit /v1/chat/completions (streaming off) and /v1/embeddings. No function calls. Mostly short prompts, some batch embedding jobs.
Nikhil (SRE): Need exact RPS/TPS numbers. 25 RPS sustained = ~1500 RPM. Bursts to 50 RPS — for how long and what's acceptable latency? Also what's their retry/backoff behavior?
Ryan (Sales): Bursts for up to 20 minutes scattered across the window. Latency SLO: <300ms p50 ideal, <800ms p95. They can accept 10% tail degradation during bursts.
Emma (SE): OK. We can provision an ephemeral scoped key with a 2-hour TTL and IP allowlist. Example key create command:
```bash
redwood keys create --project hh-poc --scopes generate,embeddings --ttl 2h --ip 35.235.20.0/24
```
Nikhil (SRE): Ops check: our hosted default rate per key is 10 RPS. We can create an exception to 30 RPS for that key for the 2-hour window if sign-off. 50 RPS bursts would require a temporary routing to dedicated pool or graceful fallback to a smaller model. OpsBot, confirm quota availability.
OpsBot: Automated quota scan complete — US-west capacity shows spare headroom for 2 hours; manual approval required for >30 RPS. Create ticket #INC-1972468 for tracking.
Aisha (Security): For IP allowlist and ephemeral key this is fine. Need a signed DPA and confirmation they won't send PHI. If they will, we need a Private or Dedicated setup. Please confirm data sensitivity.
Jon (Billing): Temporary rate increase will be billed at standard hosted rates. If usage > $1k threshold we need PO upfront. Ryan, any budget constraints?
Ryan (Sales): They have a POC budget of ~$1k for the week. They agreed to pay overage if needed — I'll get verbal ok and DM PO to @Jon.
Emma (SE): Plan B if we can't hit 50 RPS bursts: suggest client enable client-side batching + 2 concurrent keys, and we'll provide sample retry/backoff config. That should simulate the load within 30 RPS per key.
Nikhil (SRE): I'll prepare the exception: raise to 30 RPS sustained for key `poc-helios-1972`, with a monitored burst flag. If we get higher sustained >30 RPS will auto-failover to lower tier and alert oncall.
Ryan (Sales): Thanks everyone — please tag me when done. Demo is tomorrow 09:00 PST. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Ticket #INC-1972468 created and assigned to @Nikhil. Approval pending from @Jon for billing and @Aisha for data sensitivity.
Jon (Billing): Approved on billing side pending PO. Leave a note with estimated spend.
Aisha (Security): Confirmed no PHI. Approve IP allowlist + ephemeral key for demo window. :white_check_mark:
Nikhil (SRE): Exception created, key `poc-helios-1972` issued (TTL 2h). Rate set: 30 RPS sustained, burst flag enabled. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/monitor/holios-poc
Ryan (Sales): Got it — forwarding key to client via secure channel. Will DM PO. Good luck tomorrow!
